research_question: Can any preregistered reduced mechanism convert the frozen A054 coherent-but-nonconfining three-filament states into restoring, Kelvin-bounded and nonlinear-ringdown-bounded branches without per-candidate retuning or relaxing the v0.2 hard gates?
objective: Identify the minimal registered closure class, if any, that produces held-out dynamical recovery under the original A054-v0.2 thresholds while preserving topology and numerical convergence.
null_hypothesis: H0: none of the registered mechanism arms recovers a held-out and numerically certified dynamically confined branch beyond the Biot-Savart baseline.
alternative_hypothesis: H1: at least one preregistered mechanism arm and one globally selected gain recovers held-out dynamically confined branches under unchanged v0.2 gates.
assumptions: The frozen v0.2 anonymous geometries are discovery states, not physical particle identifications.
The source-native KnotPlot three-component links form a held-out geometric/provider confirmation cohort.
Injected core-stress and elastic terms are reduced effective closures; neither is claimed as a first-principles Euler pressure or shear-modulus derivation.
A single global dimensionless gain is selected per arm on discovery and reused unchanged on held-out confirmation; per-candidate fitting is forbidden.
Original A054-v0.2 restoring, Kelvin, ringdown, topology and convergence thresholds remain unchanged.

steps.operation: Verify frozen protocol, public-source blindness and exact input hashes before numerical work.
Load exact frozen v0.2 anonymous discovery geometries and opaque source-native confirmation geometries.
Validate analytic null behavior, rigid-objectivity and mechanism-field normalization on the Python FP64 reference.
Blindly evaluate BASE, CORE, ELASTIC and CORE+ELASTIC arms over the preregistered gain grid on discovery; select one global gain per arm without semantic labels.
Apply each selected arm/gain unchanged to the held-out opaque source-native confirmation cohort.
For confirmed recovery cells, require resolution convergence and C++/OpenMP FP64 parity; RPO/Floquet is evaluated only after restoring/Kelvin/ringdown recovery.
Assess evidence-class eligibility and mechanism minimality without promoting simulation-only evidence to physical support.

falsification_criteria.criterion: No registered arm produces a held-out recovery under unchanged v0.2 hard gates.
A discovery recovery disappears when the selected gain is transferred unchanged to held-out source-native geometries.
A held-out recovery fails spatial/temporal convergence or C++/OpenMP FP64 parity.
Only a multi-mechanism arm recovers while its registered single-mechanism ablations do not.

edge_cases: multiple arms tie in recovery count
predictions: Baseline reproduces the nonconfining v0.2 behavior within numerical tolerance.
If finite-core cohesive stress is essential, CORE-containing arms should recover cells that ELASTIC alone does not.
If transverse/curvature elasticity is essential, ELASTIC-containing arms should recover cells that CORE alone does not.
If both are required, only CORE+ELASTIC should transfer to held-out geometries.
